parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the workgroup list. The value starts from 1.
Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.
Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the workgroup. Valid values:

- NotStarted: The workgroup is not started.

- InProgress: The workgroup is in progress.

- Cutover: The workgroup is being cut over.

- Completed: The workgroup is completed.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The array of tags. The array can contain 1 to 20 tags. If the array contains multiple tag objects, the tag keys cannot be the same.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the workgroup. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the workgroup. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string. The value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: WorkgroupId
parameters.description: A list of workgroup IDs. You can specify up to 50 workgroup IDs.
